verdict.rationale: Unit's own docs say the API can send and receive money over wires and real-time payments. Its sandbox simulates wire receipt, and Unit states it has direct Federal Reserve connectivity, which supports wires and faster rails through one platform API. However, the evidence never names RTP or FedNow specifically and shows no per-rail capability documentation, so only part of the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: explicit RTP and FedNow origination and receipt, per-rail capability and limit documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, the faster rails are there when I need them — domestic wires, RTP, and FedNow origination and receipt through the same API, with per-rail capabilities documented

citations.quote: Send and receive money using payment capabilities including ACH, wires, real-time payments, checks, and international payments, with settlement-level transaction visibility.
Unit is a registered Federal Reserve service provider with direct connectivity to Federal Reserve systems on behalf of partner banks.
Sandbox exposes a set of simulation-specific endpoints
